default_pillar_templates._note: Legacy format - used as fallback if athlete has no training_pillars

personas._description: Starting templates for different athlete types. LLM uses these as suggestions, then personalizes via conversation.

endurance_athlete.description: Runner, cyclist, triathlete, swimmer - focused on aerobic events and distance
endurance_athlete.key_focus: Aerobic base, injury prevention, event-specific preparation

strength_athlete.description: Powerlifter, bodybuilder, CrossFitter - focused on strength and muscle

recreational.description: General fitness, health maintenance, stress relief - no specific events

return_from_injury.description: Recovering from injury - conservative progression, focus on rehab
return_from_injury.key_focus: Safe progression, pain-free movement, building back capacity

trail_ultra.description: Ultra-distance trail running (50km+). Demands time on feet, climbing strength, and mental resilience.

key_sessions.notes: Build to 3-4 hours by peak. Mimic race terrain - technical trails, elevation
Long Saturday + medium-long Sunday. Teaches running on tired legs
Hill repeats, stair climbing, or sustained climbs. Build climbing economy
Single-leg work, eccentric loading for downhills, core stability

phase_guidance.base: Focus on aerobic volume. Easy long runs building duration. Strength foundation.
phase_guidance.build: Add vertical gain. Increase long run terrain difficulty. Back-to-back weekends.
phase_guidance.peak: Race-simulation efforts. Nutrition/hydration practice. Course-specific prep.
phase_guidance.taper: Reduce volume 40-60%. Keep short sharp efforts. Rest legs for race day.

multi_day_mtb.description: Multi-day mountain bike stage race. Requires endurance, bike handling, and recovery between stages.

key_sessions.notes: Build to 3-4 hours. Include climbs and technical sections
Consecutive day riding to simulate stage race fatigue
Sustained climbing at race pace. Build climbing endurance
Wattbike technique drills (if available). Pedaling efficiency gains compound over multi-day racing.
Core, lower back, shoulders for bike position. Single-leg power

phase_guidance.base: Build saddle time. Easy long rides. Strength and mobility focus. Add technique work if indoor bike with analytics available.
phase_guidance.build: Add intensity on climbs. Increase ride duration. Technical skills. Continue technique 1x/week.
phase_guidance.peak: Race-pace efforts. Equipment dialed. Practice nutrition strategy.
phase_guidance.taper: Short sharp rides. Keep legs fresh. Mental preparation.

road_cycling.description: Road cycling events. Sustained aerobic effort with group dynamics.

key_sessions.notes: Build endurance base. Include varied terrain

phase_guidance.base: Build aerobic base with volume. Easy spinning.
phase_guidance.build: Add tempo and threshold work. Group rides.

tournament.description: Multi-game tournament (Ultimate, Padel). High intensity with short recovery between games.

key_sessions.notes: Short sharp efforts mimicking game demands

phase_guidance.base: Build aerobic base to support repeated efforts.
phase_guidance.taper: Fresh legs. Light technical work only.

pre_sleep_stretching.description: 10-15 min targeted stretching before bed after long efforts. Focus: parasympathetic activation for better sleep quality.
principles: Slow, gentle holds (30-60 secs) - no bouncing

suggested_sequence.name: Child's pose with reach
suggested_sequence.notes: Extended arms - lat and shoulder release

cycling.rationale: Cycling creates hip flexor tightness, thoracic kyphosis, and neck strain. Focus on opening front body and releasing spine.

suggested_sequence.name: Supine hamstring stretch
suggested_sequence.notes: Each leg - use strap if needed

running.rationale: Running impacts posterior chain and hip flexors. Focus on calves, hamstrings, and hip opening.

suggested_sequence.name: Child's pose
suggested_sequence.notes: With deep breathing - nervous system reset

high_intensity.rationale: High-intensity creates systemic stress. Focus on calming nervous system with longer holds and breathing.

ask_athlete: Any specific areas feeling tight tonight?
Any areas to avoid due to injury?

cycling_technique.description: Indoor cycling technique work using Wattbike analytics (Polar View, PES, L/R balance). Best done during base phase when volume allows for skill development.
when_to_use: Base building phase (time for skill work)
Athlete has indoor bike with analytics (Wattbike, Stages, etc.)
Preparing for long events (efficiency gains compound over hours)

pes.name: Pedaling Effectiveness Score
pes.description: Wattbike metric measuring power application through pedal stroke
pes.notes: Higher PES = less wasted energy, smoother power delivery

lr_balance.name: Left/Right Power Balance
lr_balance.description: Percentage of power from each leg
lr_balance.notes: Perfect balance is rare. Focus on consistency, not perfection.

polar_view.name: Polar View Display
polar_view.description: Visual representation of power through pedal stroke
polar_view.target: Smooth peanut shape without flat spots or spikes

single_leg_drills.purpose: Identify and correct dead spots, build neuromuscular patterns
single_leg_drills.execution: Unclip one foot, pedal with single leg. Focus on pulling through bottom of stroke.
single_leg_drills.watch_for: Clunking at top/bottom = dead spots. Smooth = good.

cadence_pyramids.execution: Progressive cadence increase then decrease. Stay seated, quiet upper body.
cadence_pyramids.watch_for: Bouncing in saddle, grip tightening, shoulder tension = too fast

spin_ups.execution: Gradually increase cadence to max smooth RPM, hold briefly, recover
spin_ups.watch_for: Find the point where smooth becomes choppy - that's your current limit

polar_view_focus.purpose: Real-time technique feedback under moderate load
polar_view_focus.execution: Watch Polar View display, adjust technique to maintain smooth shape
polar_view_focus.watch_for: Spikes = power surges. Flat spots = dead spots. Asymmetry = L/R imbalance

technique_focus.description: Pure technique session - low intensity, high focus

progression: Week 1-2: Focus on drills, establish baseline PES/balance
Week 3-4: Add cadence work, track improvements
Week 5-6: Integrate with intensity, measure technique under load
success_criteria: Smooth cadence up to 110+ RPM without bouncing
